Projections connect the First Way's witness to the existing endpoint 593d7307 (930c6d8c) and to the root-route stage-one node STMT-NECESSARY-CONCRETE-AT b19ffd92 (b6d7c434 from 11958874; 402e5643 from f9208664 with B0'). frontier-diff vs the merge base 08d5aa22: 10 verified support alternatives added (including the b19ffd92 option through the First Way, and 7bce7007's existing Fifth Way supports, which now reach the root), 6 bare premises added (B0, B0', irreflexivity, B4, B2 or B4, B6), route cost unchanged; no premise closed. Models (controls 2b71a3ad, finite frames with two respects, esse and motion, structural surrogates; the moved thing is in POTENCY_1 in the respect in which it is moved): bruteFirst (M1/M2/M4) is a first-in-being, pure-act, simple mover satisfying both existing potency/modality bridges nonvacuously (every potency is of the contradictory; what can fail to be possibly is not) that is contingent and uncaused: B2, B4, the esse-tied half B4b, B2 or B4, B6 and the grounding closure fail, so pure act alone, essence-esse identity alone and firstness alone leave necessity open. conserved (M3): a pure-act mover caused in esse by a prior being, contingent; firstness fails, so POTENCY_1 pure act does not exclude received esse. Models 2-10 omit every other premise in turn; model 11 satisfies every route nonvacuously; model 12 (M5, three beings) has two necessary actual first pure-act roots, the mover and an idle being, so no endpoint identifies the mover with every necessary root. Shared dependencies: all routes share the prima via conclusion, B0 and pure act; firstness 74eb9113 enters A, A or B and grounding directly, C through the derivation of simplicity and B through two of the five derivations of pure act (the Lambda.7 de01c6e3 and temporal e67e0be2 derivations avoid it); B2 through B6 shares B6 with C; B3 is derived through 7a63a3fe. Rivals under the substantive objection standard: against B4 as typed (POTENCY_1 in any respect, no tie to esse) no substantive objection is identified: the distinctness of the two channels in DISAMB-POTENCY-IN-SUBJECT-VS-IN-ANOTHER shows only that B4 is not a conceptual truth, the conserved model only that it is needed, and a counterexample would be a contingent being in POTENCY_1 in no respect, which presupposes the denial of the target (open B5 question); with excluded middle B4 is equivalent to 'every pure-act being existing at w is necessary at w' (law 3), so route B relocates the question; B2 or B4 is the weakest bridge as typed but is not the q.9 a.2 pair of channels without two unrecorded bridges (contingency to MUTABLE_3; another's power over esse to a distinct esse-cause); against B2 and B2 or B4 the brute contingent first being (same rival as SpineRivalsRootEsse.ContingentRootSurvives at the necessary-root node; price: a contingent existent that is in POTENCY_1 in no respect and has no distinct cause of its esse, with no explanation of its existence); against B6 no specific substantive objection identified beyond that rival, but represented essence-esse identity has no modal force by itself (DISAMB-ESSENTIAL-VS-ACCESSIBLE-EXISTENCE). No substantive objection identified to B0, B0' or irreflexivity. Provisional judgment (unreviewed): valid under each bundle; pure actuality on POTENCY_1 does not by itself entail necessity; it does work only with firstness, closing the potency disjunct of B2 or B4; A or B dominates A (A's bundle entails it); the grounding route adds no modal crux beyond the closure c71c068c; other route comparisons are not decided (no assessed warrant differential; logical weakness is not warrant); the result is cross-family convergence on one witness, not independent corroboration against brute contingency.
